svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits per month
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing: 43,180 commits since 2017, through Oct 21, 2026. Columns show commits per month on a log scale, where each gridline is ten times the one below. Yearly totals: 2017: 0; 2018: 17; 2019: 0; 2020: 7; 2021: 255; 2022: 206; 2023: 84; 2024: 407; 2025: 344; 2026: 41,860. Busiest month: Oct 2026 so far, with 21,072 commits. First commit: Jul 2018. Counts cover every commit on the default and Pages branches of repositories Sirui owns or works in; GitHub's contribution calendar also counts pull requests, issues, and reviews.
svg.text: 97% of them in 2026 alone · commit #1,000 landed in Jan 2025
Each gridline is 10× the one below. The faded bar is October so far.
